title: Abdulkadir Mohamed Nur 'Jaamac' Takes Office as Speaker of Somalia's Federal Parliament
detail: Abdulkadir Mohamed Nur, known as 'Jaamac,' a former Minister of Ports and Marine Transport, was elected Speaker of the House of the People of the Federal Parliament of Somalia on August 11, 2026, winning 142 votes against 30 for his opponent. Lawmakers aligned with Puntland and Jubbaland boycotted the vote, dismissing it as illegitimate amid the ongoing constitutional standoff between President Hassan Sheikh Mohamud and the Somali Future Council opposition coalition. Jaamac formally assumed office on August 12, 2026, at Villa Hargeisa in Mogadishu, pledging to lead the House 'with fairness, transparency and unity' and to strengthen Somalia's parliamentary diplomacy with international legislatures.

title: PM Barre Tells UN Agencies and Donors to Stop Managing Somalia 'From Nairobi'
detail: Prime Minister Hamza Abdi Barre publicly urged UN agencies, donors, and international organizations operating in Somalia to change how they engage with the country, saying some still treat it as a transitional state despite functioning federal institutions and a legal framework. 'There are people who work for us who still want to run from Nairobi. It is the culture they have learned, but it is not possible now,' Barre said. He linked the criticism to the Federal Government's National Transformation Plan, which aims to move Somalia away from externally managed, transition-era systems. The remarks land as Somalia's Humanitarian Response Plan remains critically underfunded and donor fatigue deepens amid the constitutional standoff with Puntland and Jubaland.

media.caption: Prime Minister Hamza Abdi Barre addresses international engagement with Somalia, Aug 12, 2026
